name: Teatown Natural Science Summer Day Camp
description_short: Natural science day camp on Teatown's 1,000 acre preserve in Ossining, in two week sessions for children from Pre-K through grade 9. Groups by grade hike, explore streams and fields and meet the center's animals; older campers do field research and trips to nearby parks and the Hudson River.
refund_policy_summary: Withdrawals before June 16, 2027 get 75% of the total camp fee back (a 25% administrative charge is kept); no refunds after that date.
notes: Starting in 2027, a Teatown family membership ($85 or higher) is required to attend camp, unless the family applies for financial aid. Sign up for summer 2027 begins January 6 at 8 am (returning campers and siblings), January 13 for members with first time campers. 2027 fees are not posted yet; 2026 fees for a two week session were $995 member / $1,055 non-member full day ($1,235 non-member for Explorers, grades 8 to 9). Pre-K is half day 9 to 12; Kindergarten and up 9 to 3. Extended care 7:45 to 8:45 am ($100 a week) and 3 to 5 pm ($250 a week). Campus renovation continues in 2027 and transportation will be provided if needed. Session I is listed as June 28 to July 19, 2027, which overlaps Session II, so it is left out until the camp confirms.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. Summer camp page: Summer Camp 2027 Dates and Themes, four two week sessions. Scholarships by application by May 1.
